title: Scam-safe senior phone launcher
problem: Standard phones expose search, ads, unknown callers, and app stores. Caregivers want a locked experience with calls/texts/camera/calendar only and aggressive scam blocking.
solution: Custom Android launcher + allowlists + optional DNS/firewall + caregiver admin PIN. Can pair with the auto-answer project later.
whyWidespread: Scams against older adults are a mass-market pain point; dementia multiplies the risk.
targetUser: Caregivers provisioning a phone or tablet for a person with cognitive impairment.
fitForGeorge: Pure software product with optional setup service. Strong fit.

feasibility.notes: Launcher + device owner mode is doable; support and OEM variance are the grind.

market.willingnessToPay: Subscription ($5-$15/mo) or one-time app ($20-$60) plus optional setup fee.
market.profitHypothesis: Software/subscription economics are attractive if retention is good.

softwarePlan.summary: Android launcher MVP with allowlisted apps/contacts/sites and caregiver PIN.

unsolved: Whether to merge with auto-answer project

notes: Strong, but may collapse into the auto-answer phone kit as one product line.
